summary: Implemented the speed indicator feature. In rich/progress.py: TaskProgressColumn gained a show_speed keyword (default False) and a classmethod render_speed that scales speed via filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix and returns styled Text; its render shows speed when the total is None and show_speed is on. Module-level track() gained show_speed=True as its last parameter, documented, and passes it to TaskProgressColumn. Progress.track now sets the total to None for non-Sized iterables instead of raising. In tests/test_progress.py, added test_task_progress_column_speed and removed the two ValueError assertions. CHANGELOG.md has a new Unreleased/Added line. Nothing was run or committed; verification was by reading the code only. One note: Progress.get_default_columns still builds a plain TaskProgressColumn(), which the spec did not cover.
